In turn, these advances led to lipid nanoparticles enabling the RNA medicine Onpattro and the COVID-19 mRNA vaccines, and they are now facilitating gene therapies that can potentially treat most human diseases.

records.title: How single-atom catalysis transformed from a nanoscience curiosity into a new paradigm for heterogeneous catalysis
records.description: Single-atom catalysis has reshaped heterogeneous catalysis by shifting its central focus from surface and interface to isolated atom-centred active sites. This transition establishes a new paradigm for understanding reactivity, integrating experiments and theory, and advancing heterogeneous catalysis from empirical observations toward a more predictive and precise science.

records.title: How display technology adopted quantum dots
records.description: Quantum dots — semiconductor nanocrystals whose optical and electronic properties can be tuned by controlling their size, composition and surface chemistry — have found commercial success for display technologies. Their transition from nanophotonics research into an applied modern nanotechnology exemplifies the bottlenecks that many emerging technologies must overcome on the path to commercialization.

records.title: How spin-transfer-torque magnetoresistive random access memory bridged spintronics research and the microelectronics industry
records.description: Spin-transfer torque magnetoresistive random access memory has emerged as a leading non-volatile memory technology replacing embedded Flash in diverse fields including aerospace, automotive and healthcare applications.

records.title: From DNA to full-length proteins through nanopore sequencing
records.description: Nanopore protein sequencing has advanced from a theoretical ambition to a practical technology, overcoming major challenges in protein unfolding, transport and signal detection to achieve single-amino-acid and post-translational modification sensitivity. With both full-length and peptide-based approaches progressing towards commercialization, the field is now focused on scaling throughput and refining analysis tools to unlock a new generation of single-molecule proteomics.

records.title: Where is my graphene battery?
records.description: After years of hype and research, there is still no graphene battery electrode in mass production, but researchers say the material shows promise for energy storage.

records.title: How metasurfaces transformed flat optics into information optics
records.description: Metasurfaces became a technology not by making lenses thinner. They became one by concentrating in a single manufacturable layer what conventional optics achieves only with bulky assemblies: sorting light by polarization, spectrum and angle, and delivering rich information, not just images, to the computation behind the light sensor.

records.title: Thermal conductance of atomic-scale glass reaches 40% of quantum limit
records.description: Heat flows coherently through an atom-scale break junction of amorphous silicon dioxide at room temperature, reaching 40% of the quantum limit and revealing that structural disorder does not fundamentally impede atomic-scale phonon transport.

records.title: Atomic-scale visualization of three-dimensional magnetization vectors with competing spin Hamiltonian interactions
records.description: A beam-shift-based 4D EMCD method is developed that can map 3D spin vectors across individual atomic planes and reveal how competing spin Hamiltonian interactions drive asymmetric spin rotation in canted antiferromagnetic YFeO 3 .

records.title: The very hungry nanopillar
records.description: Earlier this year, we packed up a small version of our world and headed to Bird Rock Elementary in La Jolla, California, to meet two dozen second graders waiting to do science. We brought with us a plant molecular farming lab, plush virus nanoparticles, and enough curiosity to fill a classroom. We began with wonder.

records.title: Stereochemical origin of potential hysteresis in lithium metal batteries with lithium-rich cation-disordered rocksalt positive electrodes
records.description: Multiscale physicochemical and electrochemical characterizations demonstrate that atomic-scale structural distortion and nanoscale short-range ordering govern the thermodynamic and kinetic components of potential hysteresis in Li||DRX cells.

records.title: Stopped-light-enhanced gravitational force sensing
records.description: A torsion-pendulum gravitational-force sensor with an optical microcavity readout leverages coupled photon–phonon effects to enhance sensitivity to the tiny gravitational pull from a millimetre-sized source mass.

records.title: Single-crystal rhombohedral boron nitride wafers for integrated sliding ferroelectric memory
records.description: Four-inch rhombohedral-stacked boron nitride wafers are reproducibly synthesized through a step-templated interfacial epitaxy strategy, exhibiting high-density, fast-speed and non-volatile memory performances.

records.title: Sensing forces that shape tumours
records.description: MRI-responsive hydrogel microparticles embedded with zinc ferrite nanoparticles enable deep-tissue mapping of dynamic tumour compression, revealing that transient stress surges, rather than cumulative mechanical load, lead to the epithelial–mesenchymal transition and tumour remodelling.

records.title: Mechanical stress remodelling drives epithelial–mesenchymal transition in the tumour microenvironment
records.description: Magnetic-resonance-responsive sensors comprising zinc ferrite nanoparticles embedded in hydrogel microparticles enable mapping of tissue stress, revealing that acute stress surges, rather than cumulative mechanical load, drive epithelial–mesenchymal transition and tumour remodelling.

records.title: Two-dimensional materials for advanced back-end-of-line and wafer backside technologies
records.description: Two-dimensional materials offer low resistivity, strong thermal management and back-end-of-line compatibility, making them promising for advanced interconnects, backside power delivery and boosting efficiency in next-generation semiconductor chips.

records.title: Monolithic 3D integration of atomic-layer-deposited oxide semiconductors on 200-mm silicon wafers
records.description: Monolithic 3D integration of oxide semiconductor devices on a 200-mm wafer is demonstrated, enabling vertically interconnected logic and memory and supporting the design of an energy-efficient AI accelerator.

records.title: Stretchable quantum dot displays achieve high definition
records.description: Thermally assisted intaglio transfer printing and interfacial ligand engineering turn quantum dots into stretchable, ultrabright and high-definition displays.

records.title: High-resolution intrinsically stretchable quantum-dot displays through thermally assisted intaglio transfer printing
records.description: Innovative ligand engineering and thermally assisted intaglio transfer printing enhance charge injection and pixel resolution in stretchable quantum-dot light-emitting diodes, achieving high efficiencies and luminance while maintaining mechanical integrity under deformation.

records.title: Single-gate, multipartite entanglement on a room-temperature quantum register
records.description: This work demonstrates a parallelized four-qubit entangling gate on a room-temperature spin register, and it operates ten times faster than sequences of two-qubit gates with reduced errors.

records.title: Demonstration of on-chip all-optical switching of magnetization in integrated photonics
records.description: This study demonstrates on-chip all-optical switching by integrating magnetic memory elements with photonic circuits, establishing a route towards fully integrated magneto-photonic systems for ultrafast and energy-efficient information technologies.

records.title: Author Correction: Half-wave nanolasers and intracellular plasmonic lasing particles
Author Correction: Nanopore-enabled time-resolved monitoring of catecholamine-related phenylalanine metabolism
How nanophotonics can drive optical computing toward practical applications
records.description: This Review discusses photonic platforms that have already shown programmability, high integration density, and stability, and that can support large-scale AI models, edge computing, and logic and scientific computing.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Edge-sharing RuO 2 single layer for stable and low overpotential acidic water electrolysis
Structured light–matter interaction in semiconductor cavity quantum electrodynamics
records.description: Structured light–matter interaction at the single-photon level is demonstrated in a coupled quantum-dot–micropillar system, enabling cavity-enhanced single-photon emission with spin-locked orbital angular momentum and tunable spin–orbit entanglement.

records.title: Charge-switching ionizable lipids lower the toxicity of lipid nanoparticles
records.description: Charge-switching S-lipids generate S-lipid nanoparticles that are neutral or negative at physiological pH but become cationic in acidic endosomes, enabling nucleic acid delivery with reduced inflammation compared with conventional LNPs.

records.title: Switchable single-atom catalysts for highly selective C–C coupling in direct methane oxidation
records.description: Single copper atoms on boron nanosheets dynamically and reversibly switch to clusters, enabling the direct conversion of methane to acetic acid with 97% selectivity and high activity without the requirement for carbon monoxide.

records.title: Defect-bound states of exciton condensate as an analogue of the Yu–Shiba–Rusinov state
records.description: Impurities in a quantum exciton condensate create bound electronic states, as visualized in Ta 2 Pd 3 Te 5 , that are analogous to spin impurities in superconductors, enabling microscopic control of excitonic quantum matter.

records.title: Quantum-well metasurface for free-space-accessible enhanced nonlinear polarization
records.description: Interband-engineered quantum wells integrated with a resonant metasurface yield giant near-infrared-to-visible optical nonlinearities.

records.title: Dynamic biomass micro–nanofibre framework for entrapment and clearance of gastrointestinal microplastics
records.description: An oral biocompatible alginate–chitin micro–nanofibre framework captures ingested microplastics through pH-responsive electrostatic adsorption and physical entrapment, accelerating excretion, restoring the intestinal barrier and microbiome in mice.

records.title: Hidden valleys spin perovskite optoelectronics up
records.description: Converting continuous spin textures into discrete hidden valleys via local symmetry breaking unlocks long-lived, room-temperature spin control in two-dimensional perovskites.

records.title: Nanopore-enabled time-resolved monitoring of catecholamine-related phenylalanine metabolism
records.description: An engineered bionanopore enables single-molecule tracking of catecholamine biosynthesis from phenylalanine to adrenaline, revealing time-resolved pathway dynamics and showing how impaired dehalogenase activity disrupts neurotransmitter production.

records.title: Edge-sharing RuO 2 single layer for stable and low overpotential acidic water electrolysis
records.description: Single-layer 1T-RuO 2 with an edge-sharing structure enables efficient electron transport and delivers ultralow overpotential, high activity and long-term stability for acidic water electrolysis in a proton-exchange membrane water electrolyser.

records.title: A self-assembled peptide forms α-helical nanopores for ultrasensitive biomarker profiling
records.description: An engineered peptide self-assembles into α-helical octameric flexible nanopores with tunable diameters and conductances, enabling conformationally programmable biomolecular sensing.

records.title: The analytical challenge of measuring micro- and nanoplastics in human tissues
records.description: As evidence of micro- and nanoplastics in human tissues continues to grow, researchers are racing to improve analytical methods and establish standardized measurements that can reliably quantify their presence and potential health impacts.

records.title: Dipole glasses unlock the cryogenic frontier of energy storage
records.description: Unit-cell-level dipole frustration suppresses polar freezing, enabling efficient capacitive energy storage at liquid-helium temperatures.

records.title: Cryogenic energy storage enabled by dipole glass with unit-cell-level polar disorder
records.description: A dipole glass with unit-cell-scale polar disorder, nanoengineered near the antiferroelectric–paraelectric phase boundary, enables dielectric energy storage with high energy density and efficiency from 300 K to 4 K, addressing a key limitation of relaxor ferroelectrics at cryogenic temperatures.

records.title: Decoupling mechanical strain in microneedle biointerfaces
records.description: Microneedle electrochemical sensors featuring sub-micrometre tips, nanostructured surfaces, and a strain-isolated biointerface decouple tissue motion from the sensing environment, enabling biomolecular monitoring during free movement.

records.title: Author Correction: Electrostatic regulation of solvation chemistry enables ampere-hour-scale high-energy lithium metal batteries
Hydration layer mediates near-frictionless sieving of monovalent ions
records.description: A covalent organic framework monolayer membrane enables high selectivity and flux for the separation of Li + from Na + and K + . Ion transport is regulated by attraction and repulsion between bound and migrating ions via hydration-layer interactions, enabling selective transport without full dehydration.

records.title: Bioresorbable and optically readable triboelectric implants enabled by nanoscale iridophosphors
records.description: A battery-free, bioresorbable triboelectric implant combines ultrasound energy harvesting with visible phosphorescent self-reporting, enabling non-invasive, long-term in vivo tracking of implant integrity, function and resorption for up to 38 weeks

records.title: Point-like photovoltaic junction in 2D semiconductor homobilayer
records.description: The miniaturization of a semiconductor junction down to a single dopant is demonstrated; the tiny junction converts light into electrical current within a nanometre-sized spot, a signal that is subsequently detected across the much larger semiconducting homobilayer.

records.title: Nanophotonics beyond miniaturization
records.description: Across light generation, transmission, amplification, modulation and detection, nanoscale design is transforming photonics from an exercise in miniaturization into a platform for engineering optical functions.

records.title: Shape, strain and spin texture as a modern triad for magnetic materials
records.description: This Review discusses the role of inhomogeneous strains, geometrically broken spatial symmetries and curvature-induced magnetoelectric coupling mediated by spin textures for the realization of future nanoelectronic devices.

records.title: Multi-element nanoscale doping of iron-rich sodium layered oxides enables ampere-hour-level Na-ion batteries
records.description: Multi-element nanoscale doping suppresses electrochemomechanical failure caused by unstable Fe coordination in Fe-rich Na layered oxides, yielding long-lifespan ampere-hour-level Na-ion batteries.

records.title: Programmed membrane breaching with nanosyringes unlocks control over biochemical responses in synthetic cells
records.description: A nanodevice inspired by bacterial contractile injection systems enables reversible, fuel-actuated membrane penetration and spatio-temporally controlled cargo delivery for programmable biochemical regulation in synthetic cells.

records.title: A programmable DNA origami nanosyringe for directed membrane translocation
records.description: A membrane-anchoring nanodevice that integrates reversible, fuel-driven mechanical actuation enables programmable membrane penetration, cargo delivery and spatiotemporal regulation of biochemical reactions in synthetic cells.

records.title: A high-fibre diet-derived microbial polyphenol metabolite boosts T-cell stemness in cancer immunotherapy
records.description: 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid (DHB), a molecule produced by the gut microbiota from dietary fibre, promotes T cell stemness and boosts the anti-tumour efficacy of immunotherapies in multiple mouse tumour models.

records.title: Oral nano-delivery of a gut microbial metabolite enhances T cell stemness for cancer immunotherapy
records.description: A nano-emulsion that delivers the gut microbial metabolite 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid in a prodrug form enhances T cell stemness and boosts the efficacy of immunotherapy approaches in different murine cancer models.

records.title: Author Correction: Black phosphorus nanosheets boost mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation improving immunotherapy outcomes
Radial nanochannel-array carbon enables high-performance intermetallic fuel cell catalysts
records.description: Hollow nanocarbon spheres containing an ordered radial nanochannel array were used as supports to design high-performance intermetallic nanoparticle fuel cell catalysts. They overcome the trade-off between the degree of ordering in the intermetallic phase and nanoparticle dispersion.

records.title: Spectral biophysical cytometry with nanosensors reveals remodelling of immune cells in atherosclerosis
records.description: Membrane-permeant, environment-sensitive nanosensors enable high-throughput, multiparametric quantification of membrane order and mitochondrial potential, revealing immune-cell-specific remodelling and lipid-metabolic dysfunction in atherosclerosis.

records.title: A charged cage for excitons
records.description: Nanoporous monolayer metal enables 0D quantum confinement of charged quasiparticles in a monolayer semiconductor.

records.title: Electrostatic quantum nanocorral for composite charged excitons
records.description: An electrostatic excitonic corral in nanoporous-metal-defined monolayer WSe 2 achieves quantum confinement of charged excitons, generating discrete energy levels and tunable transitions between localized and extended states.

records.title: Molecules under controlled collapse
records.description: A novel platform based on standard semiconductor processing combined with a deterministic collapse strategy can lead to pristine and self-aligned interfaces with molecules.

records.title: Intrinsic plasmon canalization in the biaxial van der Waals crystal MoOCl 2
records.description: Near the Drude zero crossing where one in-plane permittivity component changes sign, the biaxial crystal MoOCl 2 supports intrinsic diffraction-free canalized plasmon polaritons at wavelengths that are controlled by flake thickness.

records.title: Self-assembled contacts for high-yield molecular devices
records.description: A soft contact approach enables scalable, damage-free integration of molecular materials into electronic devices using only conventional semiconductor manufacturing processes.

records.title: Intracellular ‘gobstoppers’ enable programmed cargo release
records.description: Living cells are engineered as microscale factories that grow programmable protein crystals with concentric layers, each capable of carrying distinct nanoscale cargo and dissolving sequentially to enable precisely timed, multi-stage payload release.

records.title: Coherent room-temperature dipole synchronization in plasmonic nanocavities
records.description: Dipoles in self-assembled gold nanogaps synchronize at room temperature, generating spatially coherent light without laser-like narrowing.

records.title: Strain-isolated microneedles for ambulatory hormonal and metabolic monitoring
records.description: A wearable microneedle platform integrating ultrasharp, skin-penetrating tips, mechanical decoupling and electrochemical biosensing enables continuous, minimally invasive molecular profiling in freely moving animals, thereby advancing real-time, personalized health monitoring.

records.title: Upconverting nanoparticles enable bioimaging with sub-ångström precision
records.description: Visualization of protein organization with ångström localization precision is limited by rapid photobleaching of conventional fluorophores. We compositionally engineered upconverting nanoparticles to blink spontaneously and indefinitely, enabling two-colour bio-imaging with sub-ångström localization precision using a single near-infrared excitation source.

records.title: Integrated blue ZnSe/ZnS quantum dot lasers on a silicon nitride platform
records.description: A CMOS-compatible fabrication methodology is developed to incorporate blue-emitting colloidal quantum dots within a silicon nitride (SiN x ) platform to create integrated blue lasers.

records.title: Spontaneous and indefinite blinking in upconverting nanoparticles for ångström-precision multicolour super-resolution imaging
records.description: Compositionally engineered, spontaneously blinking upconverting nanoparticles enable multicolour super-resolution imaging with a single excitation source and achieve localization precision down to 0.62 Å for single-molecule imaging on cell membranes.

records.title: Hidden spin-valley locking stabilizes nanosecond spin polarization in 2D perovskites
records.description: Inversion-symmetric 2D hybrid perovskite semiconductors exhibit optically excited spin lifetimes of 0.7–4.7 ns at room temperature due to intrinsic local symmetry breaking and spin-valley formation.

records.title: Unbreakable battery positive electrodes
records.description: Positive electrode active materials nanocoated with shape-memory polymers show improved electrochemical and mechanical stability during battery operation.

records.title: Magnetic brightening and nanoscale imaging of spin-polarized helical edge modes in ZrTe 5
records.description: Infrared nanoscopy resolves helical edge states in ZrTe 5 , revealing magnetic-field-induced high-frequency transport channels.

records.title: Dynamic delocalization of stress in brittle battery positive electrode active materials by shape-memory polymer nanocoating
records.description: Nanocoating of brittle positive electrode active materials with an ionically conductive polymer enables efficient operation of non-aqueous lithium metal coin cells at specific currents up to 2 A g −1 .

records.title: Immunostimulatory lipogel implant enhances cancer immunotherapy
records.description: A lipogel tailored with a differential and sustained release of combinatorial drugs can elicit tumour immunogenicity to counteract stemness-associated immunosuppression and augment immune-checkpoint-inhibitor-based immunotherapy.

records.title: Scalable transfer for industrial 2D-CMOS manufacturing
records.description: Foundry-compatible transfer of two-dimensional materials is central to angstrom-era complementary FET logic, where atomically thin channels must be moved from growth wafers to target stacks without contamination, strain or interfacial damage. Scalable delamination, bonding and wafer-level metrology are needed to bridge lab-scale device performance with 300-mm CMOS manufacturing.

records.title: Computationally guided design of bioactive nanostructures for targeted clearance of amyloid-β aggregates in Alzheimer’s disease
records.description: Gold-nanosheet-decorated ferritin nanocages, upon systemic administration, selectively disassemble fibrillar amyloid-β plaques, thereby reducing amyloid burden and improving synaptic and cognitive functions in a murine model of Alzheimer’s disease.

records.title: Catalytic profiling of extracellular vesicles maps altered cancer metabolism
records.description: By spatially and energetically aligning redox centres, metabolite-responsive nanohybrids quantify dynamic bioenergetic signatures of extracellular vesicles and map metabolic changes in the tumour microenvironment.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Halide-site-substituting spacer creates quasi-two-dimensional perovskites for vapour-deposited light-emitting diodes
Augmented reality coming into focus
records.description: Researchers believe that it will soon be possible to mass-produce waveguides for wearer-friendly AR glasses.

records.title: Fast lithium-ion transport in polymer electrolytes with rigid polyanions
records.description: The ion transport in polymer electrolytes requires a multi-scale and quantified analysis. An integrated methodology combining solid-state exchange nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and Markov chain analysis enables contribution analysis of distinct lithium-ion pathways in composite polymer electrolytes based on rigid polyanions, revealing fast and synergistic ion transport mechanisms.

records.title: The simplicity of a twist
records.description: This year’s Kavli Prize in Nanoscience recognizes the field of twistronics and exemplifies how simple approaches can shape nanoscience research.

records.title: Mark A. Ratner (1942–2026)
Nanoengineered doping overcomes sintering and grain-boundary limitations in all-solid-state lithium batteries with garnet electrolytes
records.description: Robust and lithiophobic interphases enhance grain-boundary strength in inorganic solid-state electrolytes and stabilize the interfaces of lithium metal and positive electrodes, enabling effective operation of all-solid-state batteries

records.title: Nanosecond phase ordering in ultra-large spin Hall nano-oscillator lattices for unconventional computing
records.description: Ultra-large networks of nano-oscillators can synchronize within tens of nanoseconds, exhibiting high coherence and offering a platform for exploring network science and developing next-generation high-speed unconventional computing.

records.title: Rigid polyanion architectures enable multiple ion-transport pathways and nanocluster dynamics in composite polymer battery electrolytes
records.description: Distinct lithium-ion conduction mechanisms in composite polymer battery electrolytes based on rigid polyanion architectures are identified and quantitatively characterized, providing insight into ion-transport design.

records.title: Coherent twins for manufacturing thick lithium-rich battery positive electrodes
records.description: Coherent twin boundaries enable three-dimensional Li-ion transport and reduce structural stress in Li-rich battery positive electrodes, enabling effective operation of thick electrodes in Li-ion pouch cells.

records.title: Bifunctional nanocatalyst design for polyolefin hydrocracking
records.description: This Review highlights nanoscale design principles for bifunctional catalysts in polyolefin hydrocracking, emphasizing polymer-specific transport and interface effects for scalable plastic upcycling.

records.title: Lysosome self-sorting nanodegraders for hepatic clearance of pathogenic serum mediators
records.description: Semiconducting polymer nanoparticles possess an intrinsic stiffness-oriented lysosome self-sorting property and thus can be applied for hepatic lysosomal degradation of serum mediators to treat immune-mediated diseases.

records.title: Superconductivity in twisted trilayer graphene linked to electronic compressibility oscillations
records.description: Understanding how different signatures of strong interactions relate to one another has been a long-standing challenge. Now, a technique that combines local thermodynamic measurements with transport measurements in a single twisted trilayer graphene device reveals that superconductivity coincides with characteristic oscillations in the electronic compressibility but remains independent of the correlated insulating phases.

records.title: Electrostatic regulation of solvation chemistry enables ampere-hour-scale high-energy lithium metal batteries
records.description: A strategy that modulates molecular polarity in non-aqueous electrolyte solutions enables the development, assembly and effective testing of ampere-hour-level Li-based pouch cells with multiple configurations.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Chemical efflux imaging using an annular nanosensor array for in situ bladder cancer detection
A non-viral path to efficient and safe prime editing in vivo
records.description: Solving four delivery bottlenecks enables lipid nanoparticles to achieve curative prime editing in mice.

records.title: Stepping ahead toward custom-designed autonomous motor proteins
records.description: An artificial protein walker ‘Tumbleweed’ demonstrates ligand-driven stepping on DNA tracks, marking a key advance toward modular, custom-designed autonomous motor proteins.

records.title: Spectral visualization of excitonic pair breaking at individual impurities in Ta 2 Pd 3 Te 5
records.description: Spectroscopic signatures of local excitonic depairing induced by individual impurities are directly visualized, together with spatial regulation of the excitonic order parameters, opening avenues for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena in excitonic insulators.

records.title: Clocked stepping of an artificial protein walker along a DNA track
records.description: A synthetic three-footed protein walker assembled from non-motor protein domains takes directional steps along a DNA track powered by Brownian ratchet motion driven by free energy transduction from microfluidically delivered ligands.

records.title: Charged grain boundaries limit short-circuit endurance in garnet solid-state battery electrolytes
records.description: A defect-engineering strategy applied to charged grain boundaries in lithium-based solid-state battery electrolytes homogenizes electrical transport, suppresses lithium metal nucleation and delays short-circuit failure.

records.title: Near-exceptional point degeneracy enables multilevel optical memory
records.description: The interplay between thermo-optic nonlinearity and non-Hermitian degeneracy enables a three-state optical memory in silicon photonic crystal platforms.

records.title: Monolithic manufacturing of an electrically addressable quasi-suspended nanophotonic aperture
records.description: A monolithic architecture allows electrical injection of carriers into photonic structures without perturbing the optical mode.

records.title: Nanoscale amorphization of poly(triarylamine) for efficient and stable inverted perovskite photovoltaics
records.description: Poly(triarylamine)-based devices exhibit superior stability but limited efficiency due to self-crystallization and aggregation. Amphiphilic molecules induce nanoscale amorphization of poly(triarylamine), enabling a certified quasi-steady-state efficiency of 23.01% in perovskite modules.

records.title: Halide-site-substituting spacer creates quasi-two-dimensional perovskites for vapour-deposited light-emitting diodes
records.description: Using a halide-site-substituting organic spacer, X-type quasi-two-dimensional perovskites are formed via controlled phase pinning and high-purity crystal growth with a LiF/BPA hetero-scaffold, enabling efficient vapour-deposited perovskite light-emitting diodes.

records.title: Bridging nanotechnology and mechanobiology
records.description: Nanoscience provides the conceptual and technological bridge necessary to unify physical and biological perspectives in mechanobiology.

records.title: Coherent 2D/3D van der Waals epitaxy enables single-crystal perovskite heterostructures
records.description: A strategy for coherent epitaxy of 2D/3D van der Waals perovskite heterostructures is shown to achieve atomically sharp interfaces, enable direct visualization of ordered ligand passivation, and produce spiral structures with chiroptical activity. The method is scalable to macroscopic single-crystal thin films, establishing a versatile platform for advanced optoelectronics.

records.title: Coherent 2D–3D van der Waals perovskite epitaxial heterostructures
records.description: Coherent 2D–3D van der Waals perovskite heterostructures are grown by cross-dimensional epitaxy, yielding atomically sharp interfaces, controllable domains, spiral chiroptical structures and stable gate-tunable rectification.

records.title: A high-energy hydrogen radical initiates efficient electrosynthesis of urea from CO 2 and N 2
records.description: An ionic-liquid-anchored CuBi catalyst enables efficient urea electrosynthesis from CO 2 and N 2 via a thermodynamically and kinetically favoured H · radical route, wherein H · radicals are formed through relayed electron transfer mediated by in situ-generated ionic liquid radicals.

records.title: Machine-intelligent multimodal algebot for intracavitary chemotherapy
records.description: A deep learning-guided image-feedback system enables non-invasive real-time navigation and spatiotemporally controlled intravesical drug release from magnetic biohybrid microrobots in a murine bladder tumour model, enhancing tissue penetration and therapeutic efficacy.

records.title: Ultrafast, reconfigurable all-optical beam steering and spatial light modulation
records.description: Resonant light coupling in silicon-based metasurfaces amplifies a typically weak, subfemtosecond optical non-linearity to enable pulse-limited, all-optical beam steering and spatial light modulation for high-speed photonic applications.

records.title: Amplifying tumour antigen presentations from intratumourally entrapped dendritic cells
records.description: A plant-based nanoparticle treatment that helps intratumoural immune cells release antigen-carrying vesicles triggers strong antitumour immunity, boosting radiotherapy efficacy.

records.title: Precision-engineered STING agonist nanoparticles enable coordinated mucosal-systemic immunity for durable pan-β-coronavirus protection
records.description: A nanoparticle adjuvant that safely targets the STING pathway via intranasal administration generates potent mucosal and systemic immunity against diverse coronaviruses in preclinical models and converts existing intramuscular flu vaccines into effective nasal sprays.

records.title: Optical multistability in a compact microcavity enabled by near-exceptional coupling
records.description: Optical multistability comprising three optical states is shown in a compact photonic crystal cavity, enabled by the near-exceptional coupling of high-quality-factor modes.

records.title: High-resolution nanopore peptide sensing, profiling and sequence assembly
records.description: A nickel-modified nanopore enables simultaneous, unambiguous identification of amino acids and peptides. Direct analysis or hydrolysis-based sequencing can be used for profiling and reconstruction, and detect single-residue mutations and post-translational modifications.

records.title: Link between thermodynamic correlation signatures and superconductivity in twisted trilayer graphene
records.description: Using scanning probe microscopy and transport measurements, a correlation between superconductivity and local thermodynamic parameters in magic-angle twisted graphene is observed.

records.title: Programmed synthesis of mesoporous protein crystals in cellular reactors
records.description: Programmed synthesis of porous protein crystals enables the immobilization and patterning of diverse materials and molecules with nanoscale spatial precision and allows the controlled, sequential release of biomolecules that guide cell signalling.

records.title: Efficient prime editing in vivo and in vitro using lipid nanoparticles
records.description: A systematic workflow is used to optimize lipid nanoparticle-based prime editing systems that enable efficient editing and disease correction in human cells and mouse tissue, and overcome key limitations of transient delivery.

records.title: Nano-enabled spatially selective protein degradation modulates lactate metabolism to potentiate antitumor immunity in liver cancer
records.description: A polymer-based nanoplatform that selectively degrades CD147 in liver cancer cells while sparing healthy tissues reprograms lactate metabolism, enhancing antitumor immunity and improving multiple liver cancer therapies.

records.title: Anomalous ion flows in boron nitride nanotube arrays
records.description: Vertically aligned boron nitride nanotube membranes enable anomalously ultrafast and highly selective lithium-ion transport.

records.title: Activating antiviral defenses warms up cold tumours
records.description: Nanoparticle-mediated delivery of a small metal-organic molecule induces an innate viral response in cancer cells and B-cell-mediated tumour clearance, opening a cancer immunotherapy approach that connects innate sensing and adaptive immunity.

records.title: Nanoparticles reach metastatic tumours via enhanced permeability of adjacent vessels
records.description: Nanoparticles accumulate around micrometastases through the enhanced permeability of adjacent normal vessels, a biomechanical pathway that improves nanoparticle delivery and that can be used for the diagnostics and treatment of early stage metastases.

records.title: Spatial imaging of water oxidation on single-particle catalysts
records.description: Operando nanoscale spectroscopy and imaging reveal how hole transfer and reaction intermediates interact to control water oxidation reaction pathways and kinetics across crystal facets of BiVO 4 .

records.title: Anomalous ultrafast lithium-ion transport through boron nitride nanotube membranes
records.description: Aqueous cation transport in boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) is found to be generally enhanced under both concentration gradients and electric fields. BNNTs also transport Li ions fourfold faster than K ions. BNNT membranes may enable ‘blue’ osmotic energy and efficient ion separation.

records.title: Activating a B cell immune response regresses immunologically cold tumours
records.description: A small molecule loaded in a lipid nanoparticle triggers a viral defence response and induces a strong B cell-mediated immune response, leading to cancer regression in hard-to-treat tumour models.

records.title: Programmable RNA nanostar condensates in cells
records.description: Highly tunable RNA-based synthetic condensates can be designed and engineered in mammalian cells.

records.title: Advancing mechanobiology from single molecules to complex cellular systems
records.description: The Perspective highlights key challenges in mechanobiology, including the need to engineer multicellular reference models, develop and refine biophysical methods to manipulate and quantify biomechanical properties across scales and establish theoretical frameworks to interpret complex mechanobiological phenomena.

records.title: Direct evidence of metal–ligand redox processes in positive electrodes during lithium-based battery operation
records.description: Redox electrons in lithium-based battery positive electrodes originate from hybridized orbitals. Combined characterization methods show that across the 3 d transition metal series, their origin shifts, with conventional electron counting valid in early transition metal compounds and ligand-hole redox dominating in late transition metal oxides.

records.title: Nanosensor-coated catheters for bladder cancer detection
records.description: A catheter equipped with an annular carbon nanotube sensor array enables real‑time, in situ three‑dimensional chemical imaging of cancer biomarkers, mapping the localization of early-stage tumours.

records.title: 2D transistor goes narrower
records.description: High-performance 2D nanoribbon transistors are achieved with channel width scaling down to below 100 nm.

records.title: Scaling nanoribbon transistors with monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides
records.description: Monolayer TMD nanoribbon transistors using anchored contacts and multipatterning achieve high on-state currents down to 25 nm widths, positioning them as key building blocks for future gate-all-around nanosheet electronics.

records.title: Intracellular neuronal recordings across DNA tiles
records.description: Self-inserting DNA origami tiles form stable nanopores across live neuronal membranes, enabling intracellular-like voltage recordings, small-molecule delivery and access to hard-to-reach dendrites without membrane rupture.

records.title: Hydrophobic liquid electrolyte interphases for efficient aqueous zinc batteries
records.description: A hydrophobic, electrode‑philic ether additive self‑assembles into a nanoscale liquid electrolyte interphase that decouples interfacial and bulk electrolyte behaviour, suppresses water‑driven parasitic reactions and enables efficient aqueous zinc batteries.

records.title: Reconstruction of magnon eigenfunctions by X-ray magnetic vector chronoscopy
records.description: A time-resolved X-ray technique is developed to reconstruct the full spin dynamics in magnetic materials, enabling direct access to magnon eigenfunctions and revealing hidden non-Hermitian coupling mechanisms.

records.title: Chemical efflux imaging using an annular nanosensor array for in situ bladder cancer detection
records.description: An annular carbon-nanotube nanosensor array integrated onto a medical-grade catheter enables near-infrared, in situ spatial mapping of bladder cancer-associated protein biomarker release in the bladder with 182-fold higher sensitivity than urine sampling.

records.title: Moving past size in nanoplastics research
records.description: Nanoplastics research must embrace a chemistry‑led framework and integrate molecular‑level metrics to measure, classify, regulate, and mitigate environmental and health impacts.

records.title: Room-temperature hydrogen storage of boron nanoclusters
records.description: Ni-decorated LiBH 4 nanocomposites achieve room-temperature hydrogenation of boron, enabled by synergistic catalysis and nanostructuring that promotes H 2 dissociation and B–H bond formation, a key step for practical hydrogen storage systems.

records.title: Printed devices turn neuromorphic
records.description: Artificial neurons based on printed molybdenum disulfide nanosheet networks achieve multi-order spiking dynamics that operate on physiologically relevant timescales, offering a platform for next-generation biohybrid interfaces.

records.title: Decoding the cell state from the nanoscale architecture of the cell-surface glycome
records.description: Glycan atlassing is a method for the detection of the spatial organization of cell-surface glycosylation patterns at nanoscale. It shows that such patterns reflect the functional state of the cell, providing direct evidence that the cell-surface glycome encodes biological information via its spatial organization.

records.title: A nonlinear route to altermagnetism
records.description: Nonlinear electrical responses reveal quantum geometry and signatures of altermagnetism in ruthenium dioxide thin films.

records.title: Diverse origins and chemical complexity of nanoplastics
records.description: This Perspective traces the chemical complexity arising from the material properties of nanoplastics and outlines more nuanced analytical characterization approaches to comprehensively probe their environmental fate and biological interactions.

records.title: Glycan atlassing enables functional tracing of cell state
records.description: Multiplexed super-resolution microscopy of DNA-barcoded lectins and metabolically incorporated unnatural sugars quantitatively links the nanoscale spatial relationships of glycocalyx organization and cellular state.

records.title: A durable self-adhesive high-entropy oxide sub-nanowire electrocatalyst
records.description: Seawater electrolysis is limited by the challenge of achieving both high catalyst activity and stability. Now, a self-adhesive monolithic electrocatalyst composed of high-entropy oxide sub-nanowires is developed that addresses this trade-off. Combining sub-nanoscale confinement with a high-entropy composition, the catalyst enables efficient lattice oxygen activation while maintaining structural integrity, achieving long-term stable seawater electrolysis.

records.title: Tuning interfacial polarity for stable high-potential lithium metal batteries
records.description: A molecular engineering strategy using dipolar self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) establishes interfacial polarity as a descriptor for battery electrode stability. By tuning the electronic structure of the SAM and, thus, nanometric surface environment of the positive electrode, stable operation of high-potential lithium metal batteries is demonstrated and validated through interface-sensitive in situ spectroscopy.

records.title: Tunable polaritonic topologies generated by non-local photonic modes
records.description: Tunable polaritonic skyrmions and related topological textures are generated by non-local photonic metasurfaces, enabling reconfigurable nanoscale topologies on a chip.

records.title: Self-adhesive high-entropy oxide sub-nanowire monolithic electrocatalysts
records.description: A high-entropy oxide sub-nanowire monolithic electrocatalyst with intrinsic self-adhesion enables durable seawater electrolysis via lattice oxygen activation, offering a new route to stable hydrogen production.

records.title: Programmable artificial RNA condensates in mammalian cells
records.description: Modular RNA nanostar motifs spontaneously assemble into programmable synthetic condensates in the nucleus and cytoplasm, with RNA design controlling localization, sequence-specific target recruitment and orthogonal assembly.

records.title: Silencing noise in telecom quantum emitters
records.description: Decoherence suppression in quantum dots can advance coherent telecom single-photon sources.

records.title: Chemical hardness engineering synchronizes crystallization in perovskite tandems
records.description: Chemical hardness engineering synchronizes the growth of two perovskite layers in tandem solar cells, suppressing composition gradients and defects, and enabling certified efficiencies of 30.3% (rigid) and 28.0% (flexible) with improved stability.

records.title: A quantum-coherent photon–emitter interface in the original telecom band
records.description: Waveguide-integrated InAs quantum dots produce quantum-coherent emission in the O-band with promising optical characteristics for scalable quantum networks.

records.title: Interfacial polarity modulation of positive electrode active materials for high-potential lithium metal batteries
records.description: A molecular engineering strategy using self-assembled monolayers to modulate interfacial polarity stabilizes high-potential lithium metal batteries by regulating interfacial solvent interactions and suppressing electrolyte decomposition up to 4.7 V.

records.title: Why electrodics is essential for future energy technologies
records.description: Electrodics is the branch of electrochemistry that studies electrode processes, such as charge dynamics, at their interface with the electrolyte. In this Comment, I argue that more emphasis should be placed on characterizing electrodics behaviour to facilitate both conceptual understanding and advancements in energy technologies.

records.title: Reply to: On the interpretation of astrocytic calcium signalling with graphene oxide electrodes
Peer review in the time of artificial intelligence
records.description: Used thoughtfully and transparently, generative AI may support, but must not replace, human judgment, expertise, and critical thinking in peer review.

records.title: Single indium atoms shape CO 2 -to-methanol catalysis
records.description: Monoclinic hafnia stabilizes atomically dispersed indium, creating active interfacial sites to advance selective CO 2 conversion to methanol.

records.title: On the interpretation of astrocytic calcium signalling with graphene oxide electrodes
When quantum fluids of light crystallize
records.description: A single-crystal halide perovskite integrated with a patterned nano-grating shows evidence of polaritonic supersolidity at room temperature.

records.title: Louis E. Brus (1943–2026)
Versatile heavy metal ion separation via biological ion-channel-inspired membranes
records.description: Inspired by biological CaV channels that selectively speed up Ca 2+ transport by using repulsion between single-file ions, here selective adsorbents are converted into selective membranes for the separation of heavy metal ions, including uranium, rare earth metals, copper and gold.

records.title: Enhancing antitumour nanovaccine efficacy via integrated cholesterol modulation in situ
records.description: A nanovaccine that lowers cholesterol in dendritic cell membranes improves how immune cells communicate and activate cancer-fighting T cells, enhancing tumour control in multiple preclinical models.

records.title: Hybrid antiferroelectric–ferroelectric domain walls in noncollinear antipolar oxides
records.description: Hybrid antiferroelectric–ferroelectric domains and domain walls in K 3 [Nb 3 O 6 (BO 3 ) 2 ] are reported, enabled by noncollinear ordering of electric dipole moment.

records.title: Printed MoS 2 memristive nanosheet networks for spiking neurons with multi-order complexity
records.description: Printed MoS 2 memristive networks yield spiking neurons with multi-order complexity. Thermally activated snap-back produces physiological waveforms that stimulate mouse Purkinje neurons, offering a scalable platform for bio-realistic neuromorphic hardware and brain–machine interfaces.

records.title: Giant room-temperature third-order electrical transport in a thin-film altermagnet candidate
records.description: Nanoscale RuO 2 thin films exhibit giant third-order longitudinal electrical transport and Hall effect at room temperature, making it a strong altermagnetic candidate material.

records.title: Aqueous electrolyte solutions with anion-bridged secondary solvation sheaths for highly efficient zinc metal batteries
records.description: Aqueous electrolyte solutions formulated to extend anion coordination into the secondary solvation shell improve the electrochemical utilization of the Zn metal electrode, leading to more efficient zinc battery performance.

records.title: Picosecond-scale coherent toggle switching of topological spin helicity
records.description: Femtosecond laser pulse-induced coherent helicity switching of magnetic vortices in permalloy disks on picosecond timescales is reported.

records.title: Universal logical operations in a silicon quantum processor
records.description: Five nuclear spins in silicon and the [[4, 2, 2]] code are used to demonstrate a universal logical gate set and to execute a variational quantum eigensolver computation of the ground-state energy of a water molecule.

records.title: Magnetic circular dichroism imaging of atomic-scale antiferromagnetic order at a buried interface
records.description: Atomic-column-resolved electron magnetic circular dichroism enables the direct imaging of G-type and C-type antiferromagnetic orders in DyFeO 3 and α-Fe 2 O 3 , respectively, and the identification of a one-unit-cell-thick magnetic dead layer at a buried DyScO 3 –SmFeO 3 interface.

records.title: Hydrogenated perovskite for brain-inspired computing
records.description: A hydrogenated perovskite nickelate platform integrates spatiotemporal dynamics and nonvolatile memory on a single wafer, enabling ultrafast and energy-efficient neuromorphic computation.

records.title: Peer review at the service of society
records.description: The peer review system, as we know it now, is a relatively recent achievement. It will still evolve to better fit the needs of science and society in the future.

records.title: Prodrug-tethered lipid nanoparticles for synergistic messenger RNA cancer immunotherapy
records.description: Prodrug ionizable lipid nanoparticles co-delivering an effector T cell stimulant and a T cell exhaustion inhibitor eliminate primary and distal tumours, offering a potent strategy for combination cancer immunotherapy.

records.title: Hybrid perovskite–nanograting photonic architecture enables supersolidity at room temperature
records.description: A single-crystal halide perovskite integrated in an exciton–polariton nanograting supports the formation of a supersolid phase at room temperature.

records.title: Logic‑gated nanomedicine activates STING to boost metastatic tumour immunotherapy
records.description: STING-agonistic dual-stimuli-responsive nanoparticle achieves tumour-specific immunotherapy against metastatic cancers with minimal systemic toxicity.

records.title: Protonic nickelate device networks for spatiotemporal neuromorphic computing
records.description: An all-nickelate platform based on hydrogenated perovskite nickelates combines proton-mediated transient dynamics with multilevel resistance states; this integration yields emergent spatiotemporal processing and memory for efficient neuromorphic computing.

records.title: AND logic nanoparticle for precision immunotherapy of metastatic cancers
records.description: An AND logic nanoparticle designed to respond to both acidic pH and hypoxia signals for immune activation in tumour microenvironment allows safe systemic therapy of metastatic cancers.

records.title: Ultrashort orbital diffusion length
records.description: Terahertz emission measurements challenge the prevailing view of long-range orbital transport

records.title: Evidences of subnanometre orbital diffusion length in heavy metals using terahertz emission spectroscopy
records.description: Terahertz emission spectroscopy on a ferromagnet–heavy metal heterostructure <3 nm thick reveals that orbital transport is confined to subnanometre scales.

records.title: A CMOS-compatible, scalable and compact magnetoelectric spin-torque microwave detector
records.description: The monolithic integration of a magnetoelectric antenna with a magnetic tunnel junction yields a device that converts electromagnetic waves into a d.c. voltage at sub-microwatt power levels, achieving a wireless detection sensitivity exceeding 90 kV W −1 .

records.title: Rational design of rigid mRNA folding architecture to enhance intracellular processing and protein production
records.description: A metal-ion-assisted RNA folding technique is used to modulate the mechanical interactions between RNA nanoparticles and cell membranes for improved protein expression and mRNA therapy.

records.title: Single atoms of indium on hafnia enable superior CO 2 -based methanol synthesis
records.description: Monoclinic HfO 2 stabilizes hydroxylated indium atoms that drive efficient CO 2 hydrogenation to methanol, offering a general strategy for coupling single-atom catalysis with reducible metal oxides and wide-bandgap dielectric supports.

records.title: Proton–electron temporal asynchrony on femtosecond timescales enables anti-corrosive low-iridium anodes for PEM electrolysers
records.description: Femtosecond electrochemical transient absorption spectroscopy is employed to explore the fundamental origin of anodic corrosion. It reveals that Ir corrosion originates from ultrafast proton–electron synchronization and that CeO 2 can create femtosecond-scale proton–electron asynchrony for corrosion-resistant low-Ir anodes.

records.title: Endometrium-targeted mRNA-lipid nanoparticles for treating reproductive conditions
records.description: Dysfunctions of the endometrium can impair the first stage of pregnancy: embryo implantation. We developed a strategy to deliver therapeutic mRNA to the endometrium with high specificity using a ligand-conjugated mRNA- lipid nanoparticle, restoring implantation rates in a murine model of endometrial injury with improved safety profiles.

records.title: A wafer-scale optoelectronic device unlocks monolithic 3D integration
records.description: Ordered vacancies in boridene introduce anomalous electrical anisotropy, enabling bipolar and linear photocurrent for optoelectronic computing. Additionally, the low deposition temperature and scalable heterojunction architecture of anisotropic boridene support back-end-of-line-compatible fabrication of 12-inch wafer-scale device arrays, underscoring its potential for monolithic three-dimensional (3D) integration.

records.title: Tailorable multiferroic tunnel junctions from all-van der Waals multilayer stacking
records.description: All-van der Waals multiferroic tunnel junctions exhibit four non-volatile resistance states with full layer tailorability, enabling up to 10 6 % tunnelling electroresistance, 10 4 A cm − 2 ON-state current density and room temperature operation.

records.title: Twelve-inch electrically anisotropic boridene for optoelectronic computing
records.description: Two-dimensional boridene supports neuromorphic optoelectronic computing through anomalous electrical anisotropy. Its low-temperature deposition supports back-end-of-line-compatible fabrication of twelve-inch wafer arrays.

records.title: Nanoengineering of non-aqueous liquid electrolyte solutions for future lithium metal batteries
records.description: This Review provides insights into the nanoscale physicochemical and electrochemical processes in non-aqueous electrolyte solutions for lithium metal batteries and explores emerging research directions for accelerated and iterative approaches.

records.title: Spatial light modulator via optically addressed metasurface
records.description: A metasurface-based spatial light modulator brings the pixel size down to the submicrometre scale while demonstrating real-time complex-amplitude holography, three-dimensional focusing and beam steering over a ±20.6° field of view in the visible.

records.title: Super-moiré spin textures revealed
records.description: Quantum magnetometry on twisted CrI 3 reveals moiré magnetism characterized by a period that exceeds the underlying moiré superlattice by an order of magnitude.

records.title: Author Correction: Switching graphitic polytypes in elastically coupled cavities
On-chip non-Hermitian cavity quantum electrodynamics
records.description: Operating a photonic chip that integrates quantum dots with lithium niobate resonators at an exceptional point allows for spontaneous single-photon emission with an exceptional-point-induced transparency window, a squared-Lorentzian line shape or a Fano-asymmetric line shape.

records.title: An energy gap opens and heat flows one way only
records.description: A photonic thermal diode at cryogenic temperatures has been achieved by exploiting a superconducting phase transition.

records.title: Nano-aligning composite solid electrolytes
records.description: Nano-structural alignment of organic and inorganic solid-state electrolytes enables fast ion transport and good interfacial contact in batteries.

records.title: Tandem architectures for electrochemical CO 2 reduction: from coupled atomic sites to tandem electrolysers
records.description: The authors share their perspective on tandem catalysis schemes applied in CO 2 electrolysis by defining and classifying microscopic and macroscopic site and cell tandem concepts pursued so far, providing a critical assessment and performance comparison against non-tandem systems.

records.title: Enzymatic microbubble robots
records.description: Biodegradable enzymatic microbubble robots self-propel in urea, are magnetically or chemotactically guided, provide ultrasound imaging and enhance intratumoural drug delivery with focused ultrasound.

records.title: Super-moiré spin textures in twisted two-dimensional antiferromagnets
records.description: Scanning nitrogen-vacancy microscopy unveils super-moiré spin textures emerging in twisted double-bilayer CrI 3 and provides real-space evidence of antiferromagnetic Néel-type skyrmions spanning multiple moiré cells.

records.title: Ultra-rapid nanoplasmonic colorimetry in microfluidics for antimicrobial susceptibility testing directly from specimens
records.description: A modular, point-of-care device combining hemispheric plasmonic nanoarrays and automated microfluidics enables nucleic acid amplification and metabolic cell viability assay for rapid bacterial identification and antibiotic susceptibility testing.

records.title: Nanosculpting quantum materials
records.description: A refined focused ion milling method enables the creation of three-dimensional chiral nanostructures from single-crystal quantum materials.

records.title: Quantized radio-frequency rectification in a kagome superconductor Josephson diode
records.description: Cryogenic transport measurements of CsV 3 Sb 5 nanobeams show a zero-field Josephson diode effect and radio-frequency rectification with power-dependent quantized voltage output.

records.title: Biomimetic vesicles engineered from modified tumour cells act as personalized vaccines for post-surgical cancer immunotherapy
records.description: Personalized nanovaccines derived from autologous tumour cells and engineered to display dendritic cell-like features enhance immune activation and prevent postoperative metastatic cancer in preclinical models.

records.title: Switching graphitic polytypes in elastically coupled cavities
records.description: Superlubric arrays of double-bilayer graphene enable elastically coupled switching between Bernal and rhombohedral graphene polytypes under shear forces below 1 nN with an estimated energy cost of less than 1 fJ per switching event.

records.title: A unified model for light emission from solids
records.description: This Review extends fluctuational electrodynamics, introduced originally to deal with radiation due to thermal fluctuations, to provide a unified quantitative theoretical framework that accounts for light emission processes in solids.

records.title: Revealing hidden pathways in hybrid plasmonic nanostructures
records.description: Multidimensional spectroscopy enables the observation of a rapid evolution from coherent to incoherent excitations.

records.title: Nanosculpted 3D helices of a magnetic Weyl semimetal with switchable non-reciprocal electron transport
records.description: Focused ion beam-based nanofabrication enables the production of 3D helical devices from single-crystalline Co 3 Sn 2 S 2 . The resulting chiral geometry-driven symmetry breaking produces a diode-like electrical response in transport measurements.

records.title: Engineered mucus-tethering bispecific nanobodies enhance mucosal immunity against respiratory pathogens
records.description: Engineered mucus-tethering bispecific nanobodies neutralize and entrap viruses to enhance mucosal immunity, preventing influenza infection and limiting SARS-CoV-2 transmission.

records.title: Ultrafast transition from coherent to incoherent polariton nonlinearities in a hybrid 1L-WS 2 /plasmon structure
records.description: Strongly enhanced optical nonlinearities and an ultrafast transition from coherent to incoherent polariton excitations are demonstrated by coupling an atomically thin WS 2 layer to a plasmonic nanostructure using ultrafast multidimensional spectroscopy.

records.title: Nanoscience at the centre of optical computing
records.description: Nanoscience is now redefining how light can be controlled and processed on chip.

records.title: Light could lower AI’s appetite for power
records.description: Optical computing is emerging as a low-power alternative by processing data with light instead of electrons. Advances in metasurfaces, plasmonics, and thin-film lithium niobate enable photonic circuits now being co-integrated with CMOS chips for hybrid, energy-efficient artificial intelligence (AI) computing.

records.title: Nanoparticle-mediated targeting chimeras transform targeted protein degradation
records.description: This Perspective underscores how ligand-installed nanoparticles can transcend their delivery role by incorporating targeted protein degradation (TPD) functionality, with nanoparticle-mediated-targeting chimeras, broadening the TPD toolkit.

records.title: Spatiotemporal targeting of messenger RNA lipid nanoparticles to the endometrium for the treatment of reproductive disorders
records.description: A lipid nanoparticle that delivers mRNA encoding for regenerative factors to the endometrium with high specificity restores implantation rates in a murine model of endometrial injury with potentially improved safety.

records.title: Resolving DNA origami structural integrity and pharmacokinetics in vivo
records.description: A label-free, DNA-based proximity ligation assay that uses ligatable staple pairs enables the longitudinal quantification of DNA origami structural stability dynamics in vivo, with single-helix resolution for both wireframe and lattice designs.

records.title: Excitonic negative refraction mediated by magnetic orders
records.description: Negative refraction—light bending opposite to conventional refraction—and a hyperlens effect is observed in an excitonic system in the two-dimensional magnet CrSBr. The effect is mediated by the magnetic order of the material.

records.title: Superionic composite electrolytes with continuously perpendicular-aligned pathways for pressure-less all-solid-state lithium batteries
records.description: Highly ionically conductive and flexible solid-state composite battery electrolytes are engineered by alternately stacking inorganic Li x M y PS 3 (M = Cd or Mn) nanosheets with lithium-containing organic polymers in a perpendicular orientation to the surface of the electrodes.

records.title: Lesion-targeted, severity-responsive nanoparticle delivery for RNA therapy in osteoarthritis
records.description: Matrix-INverse Targeting (MINT) nanoparticles harness cartilage changes to deliver RNA therapies, reducing degeneration and pain in osteoarthritis.

records.title: A cryogenic near-field thermal diode leveraging superconducting phase transitions
records.description: By leveraging the superconducting phase transition of Nb, a near-field thermal diode that operates near liquid helium temperature is demonstrated.

records.title: A disease-severity-responsive nanoparticle enables potent ghrelin messenger RNA therapy in osteoarthritis
records.description: Nanoparticles sensing glycosaminoglycan loss in osteoarthritis enable disease-severity-responsive delivery of ghrelin messenger RNA to cartilage lesions, reducing cartilage damage, bone thickening and pain in animal models.
